mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 metabolism of diltiazem and may potentiate antiplatelet/anticoagulant effects, increasing diltiazem concentrations and bleeding risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; counsel patient to maintain consistent turmeric intake and report unusual bruising or bleeding; consider diltiazem dose adjustment if high-dose turmeric supplementation is used.
